seen/train: A model with rotary positions is trained on texts of up to a thousand tokens. Write L train for that trained length: every position it saw was below it, from zero to nine hundred ninety nine.
seen/slow: Follow one slow pair, with theta of a tenth of a degree per position. At position m it turns by m theta, so in training its angle only ran from zero to ninety nine point nine degrees.
seen/past: Now give it a text of four thousand tokens. At position three thousand, the pair turns three hundred degrees: an angle it never had in training.
seen/fail: Queries and keys arrive turned in ways the model never learned to read. The scores go wrong, and past the trained length, quality collapses.
seen/fast: Fast pairs are fine: they went round many times in training and met every angle. The slow ones are pushed somewhere new.
squeeze/idea: Position interpolation, from Chen and others at Meta in 2023, squeezes the long text into the trained range. It divides every position by s, the stretch: the new length over L train.
squeeze/scale: Here s is four thousand over a thousand: four.
squeeze/angle: So position three thousand turns as if it sat at seven hundred fifty: seventy five degrees, an angle training made.
squeeze/last: Even the last token, at three thousand nine hundred ninety nine, turns as if at nine hundred ninety nine point seven five, below L train. Every angle stays in the trained range.
squeeze/close: The price: neighbors sit closer, turning zero point zero two five degrees apart instead of a tenth. A short fine-tune on long texts teaches the model the finer spacing.
squeeze/llama: That is how LLaMA, trained on two thousand and forty eight tokens, was stretched to thirty two thousand seven hundred sixty eight: s of sixteen, with at most a thousand steps of fine-tuning.
try/p: Try one. A model trained on two thousand and forty eight positions should read eight thousand one hundred ninety two. A pair turns a tenth of a degree per position. How far does it turn at position six thousand?
try/s: First the stretch: eight thousand one hundred ninety two over two thousand and forty eight is four.
try/raw: Without it, six thousand times a tenth is six hundred degrees, far past the two hundred and four point seven training reached.
try/scaled: With it, six thousand over four is fifteen hundred, times a tenth: a hundred and fifty degrees.
